The main form defines the first service. Additional patterns share the selected time zone and work-schedule group. The planner searches bounded route, departure, stop, dwell, and retiming options, then validates each complete timetable with OSRD. Existing stop options need a source train_schedule_id, an intermediate waypoint_key from that train's path, and up to six dwell_seconds choices; zero removes the stop. strings.The draft conflicts differ from the vali: The draft conflicts differ from the validated option ({mismatch}). No draft scenario was created.
strings.The OSRD draft is missing services: {ids: The OSRD draft is missing services: {ids}. No draft scenario was retained.
strings.{cause} Cleanup was incomplete; inspect: {cause} Cleanup was incomplete; inspect these temporary OSRD resources: {resources}
strings.The source scenario or its study changed: The source scenario or its study changed while the draft was being copied. The temporary draft was removed.
strings.Rolling-stock suggestions are unavailabl: Rolling-stock suggestions are unavailable: {details} Manual entry is still available.
strings.Created draft scenario “{name}” with the: Created draft scenario “{name}” with the selected option. The source scenario remains unchanged.
strings.Review lowest model conflict-risk score: Review lowest model conflict-risk score · Option {rank}
strings.Inspect Option {rank}, ranked lowest by: Inspect Option {rank}, ranked lowest by the experimental model's predicted conflict-risk score for existing services; review it before choosing.
strings.Please clarify the operating window for: Please clarify the operating window for each service pattern; the request contains multiple different time ranges.
strings.The stated frequency is outside the supp: The stated frequency is outside the supported interval of 1 to 60 minutes. Please choose a supported frequency for {name}.
strings.Please specify a single maximum journey: Please specify a single maximum journey time in minutes for {name}.
strings.Please specify the calendar start and en: Please specify the calendar start and end date for each service pattern.
strings.Please specify the existing service name: Please specify the existing service name exactly as it appears in OSRD.
strings.Please quote the existing service name e: Please quote the existing service name exactly as it appears in OSRD so the request can be matched to the timetable.
strings.Please confirm that the requested change: Please confirm that the requested change to {name} is a departure-time retiming.
strings.Is the {minutes}-minute shift for {name}: Is the {minutes}-minute shift for {name} an exact target or the maximum permitted shift? Please clarify before generating options.
strings.The stated weekday {weekdays} does not m: The stated weekday {weekdays} does not match {date}, which is {actualWeekday}. Should pattern {index} use the stated date or the stated weekday?
The stated date {date} is a weekend day. Should pattern {index} run on that date or on weekdays instead?
strings.Treated the single stated date {date} as: Treated the single stated date {date} as the operating date.
strings.The operating date range for pattern {in: The operating date range for pattern {index} ends before it starts. Please correct the dates.
strings.Draft retiming request for {count} exist: Draft retiming request for {count} existing services.
strings.Loaded {count} work-schedule group ID(s): Loaded {count} work-schedule group ID(s) from OSRD.
strings.Work-schedule groups are unavailable: {d: Work-schedule groups are unavailable: {details} You can still enter a known group ID.
strings.Why was the option set unsuitable? (opti: Why was the option set unsuitable? (optional)
strings.Too many existing services would change: Too many existing services would change
strings.Comma-separated schedule IDs that must n: Comma-separated schedule IDs that must not move
strings.Hourly options are ordered by OSRD feasi: Hourly options are ordered by OSRD feasibility and new conflicts, then by station/time-bucket patronage coverage. This coverage is a proxy, not passenger benefit; learned ranking remains gated.
strings.Learned ranking is not enabled for hourl: Learned ranking is not enabled for hourly plans. Options are ordered deterministically by OSRD feasibility, new conflicts, and the selected objective.
strings.Research model rank {rank} · mean existi: Research model rank {rank} · mean existing-service score {mean} · highest individual score {highest} for {train} (ID {id}). These are experimental ranking scores, not calibrated operational probabilities; use them as advisory evidence alongside OSRD validation.
strings.Enter a rolling-stock name manually in d: Enter a rolling-stock name manually in direct review mode. Suggestions load through the authenticated OSRD timetable view.
strings.Station, rolling-stock, timetable-servic: Station, rolling-stock, timetable-service, and work-schedule lookups require the authenticated OSRD timetable view. In direct review mode, enter rolling-stock names and OSRD paths manually; use Advanced for schedule IDs. Planning and validation remain available, but draft creation requires the authenticated view.
strings.Loading timetable services requires the: Loading timetable services requires the authenticated OSRD timetable view. In direct review mode, enter schedule IDs under Advanced; use the JSON field for existing stop changes.
strings.Enter a known work-schedule group ID man: Enter a known work-schedule group ID manually in direct review mode. Group suggestions require the authenticated OSRD timetable view.
strings.Station-name search requires the authent: Station-name search requires the authenticated OSRD timetable view. Enter the route in the Advanced OSRD path JSON field.
strings.OSRD did not retain the requested depart: OSRD did not retain the requested departure time for copied service {schedule}. No draft scenario was created.
strings.This window and frequency produce {count: This window and frequency produce {count} departures; the planner supports at most 50.
strings.Planner translations could not be loaded: Planner translations could not be loaded. Showing English.
strings.Frequency sets the gap between departure: Frequency sets the gap between departures.
strings.For calendar plans, a departure exactly: For calendar plans, a departure exactly at the end time is excluded; both date endpoints are included.
strings.OSRD found conflicts with existing servi: OSRD found conflicts with existing services: {services}. You can explore bounded departure shifts; OSRD will validate the full timetable before offering a draft.
strings.Window dates and times use {timeZone} an: Window dates and times use {timeZone} and are sent to OSRD as UTC. The date/time display format follows your browser’s regional settings. Times that do not exist or repeat during daylight saving changes must be adjusted to an unambiguous time.
